title: Aetolus
summary: Raleigh names Aetolus in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Aetolus, also written Aitolus, sonne of a King of Elis, and founder of the Aetolian Kingdome. Raleigh deriues the name Italus from him. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XXIV, §. I, sig. 346a
